_comment: Source of truth for which CI checks must pass before merge (issue #104). Reviewed in diffs; enforced by scripts/tests/required_checks_test.sh in CI. The live ruleset (main-protection) must match the required[] list -- drift between this file and the ruleset is detected by the scheduled canary (issue #108), because GITHUB_TOKEN cannot read branch protection and the merge-time test therefore cannot call the API. pending[] is now empty: both entries that waited on PR #100 (Release gate, Dependency review) are required, and the live ruleset (5 contexts, strict) matches this file.

required.why: Rust daemon is the encrypted store; fmt/clippy/tests are the correctness floor.
Desktop/Android client; analyze/tests catch breakage before release builds.
Secret scan, dependency audit, SBOM. Security defects get highest priority by repo principle.
The gate that decides what ships must never be advisory: this one context fans out over every platform artifact leg and the signing policy, and fails unless all of them pass.
Dependency changes must not land unreviewed.

advisory.reason: The release-gate matrix legs (one suite per runner). Not required individually: the aggregate `Release gate (artifact + signing policy)` is the single required context and fails unless every leg succeeds, so adding a suite never needs a ruleset change.
Cosmetic. A mislabeled PR says nothing about correctness.
Project-board automation; informational, and currently token-limited (issue #81).
CodeQL matrix leg; kept advisory so fork PRs (where CodeQL upload is skipped) are never permanently blocked.
Advisory until proven stable: the workflow never successfully ran before #103/#113. Revisit once it has a green history.
